in_marathi.name: ભરત
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: ભરત हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit ‘bhṛt’, meaning ‘to bear’ or ‘to carry’. In Hindu mythology, Bhart is the name of various deities and sages. It signifies being the sustainer, supporter, and protector.

in_bengali.name: ભરત
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of wealth
in_bengali.long_meaning: ભરત একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Sanskrit ‘bhṛt’, meaning ‘to bear’ or ‘to carry’. In Hindu mythology, Bhart is the name of various deities and sages. It signifies being the sustainer, supporter, and protector.
